Schematik Starter Kit

Schematik.io lets anyone build hardware with AI. Describe the device you want to make, and our AI generates the wiring diagram, the code, and the exact parts list. No experience required.

A plan means nothing without parts. We believe the best way to understand how things work is to build them yourself, so we've designed a kit that gives you everything you need to start building, the same day your idea takes shape in your hands.

That's how builders are made.
